title: Official blog knowledge stage 7
summary: This iteration adds a non-network official blog preview parser for OpenAI and Anthropic RSS, Atom, and JSON exports. Local feed/index content can now be normalized into an internal `official_blog_preview_feed` artifact that Stage 6 intake can triage without fetching live pages, storing full blog bodies, or writing public docs/data output.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog preview feed|official blog parse-feed" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Official blog feed parsing should remain network-free until the review queue contract is stable.
lessons.evidence: Stage 7 parses local RSS, Atom, and JSON fixture/export content through `createOfficialBlogPreviewFeed` and CLI `official-blog:parse-feed --input --output`, with no live fetch implementation.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future live fetching as a separate stage that writes the same internal preview feed shape before intake.

lessons.lesson: Parser output should preserve opening signal while dropping full body content.
lessons.evidence: Stage 7 tests assert HTML/script cleanup, URL/date normalization, and first-two-paragraph retention before parser output is passed into Stage 6 intake.
lessons.recommended_action: Use opening-preview fixtures for future parser regressions instead of full article snapshots.

lessons.lesson: Partial feed failures need to be isolated from healthy official entries.
lessons.evidence: JSON export tests keep one valid OpenAI item while unsupported-company and missing-URL entries are reported under `invalid_entries`.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding live sources, preserve per-entry invalid diagnostics without blocking the whole batch unless the source itself is unavailable.

suggestions.issue: Official blog RSS/Atom/index entries had no deterministic local parser into the Stage 6 intake preview shape.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 7 adds `createOfficialBlogPreviewFeed`, CLI command `official-blog:parse-feed`, RSS/Atom/JSON parsing tests, parser-to-intake integration assertions, clean `--output` behavior, and public-output path rejection.
suggestions.suggestion: Use the internal preview feed artifact as the handoff from future crawler/manual exports into the official blog intake queue.
suggestions.expected_benefit: OpenAI and Anthropic official blog discovery can move from local feed/index exports into review without leaking candidate diagnostics or full article bodies to public pages.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through deterministic parser, CLI, and intake-integration tests.
validation_evidence: official blog preview feed parses rss and atom entries for intake
official blog preview feed parses json exports with partial invalid entries
official blog parse-feed CLI writes a clean internal preview feed
official blog parse-feed CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add a reviewed authoring step that turns selected `include` queue entries into curated `knowledge/official-blogs/**` records with Chinese summaries and source links.
Add optional live fetching only after it writes the Stage 7 preview feed artifact and remains separated from public output.
